items.heading: Liberian Jollof Rice
details: Key ingredients: rice, tomato, meat, pepper, palm oil
Blend tomato and pepper into a smooth base.
Fry the base in palm oil with browned meat.
Add rice and stock, stirring to coat.
Cover and simmer until the rice is tender and infused with flavor.

items.heading: Cassava Leaf Stew
details: Key ingredients: cassava leaves, meat, fish, palm oil
Finely chop or pound cassava leaves.
Simmer the leaves for a long time with meat and fish.
Stir in palm oil and seasoning.
Cook until thick and serve over rice.

items.heading: Jollof Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.

items.heading: Palm Butter Soup
details: Ingredients: vegetables, protein or legumes, onion, garlic, stock, herbs/spices and salt.
Sauté aromatics, add the remaining ingredients and stock, simmer gently until tender, then adjust seasoning.

items.heading: Dumboy
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
